market.question: Will London have between 20-25mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: Heathrow May average precipitation ~45mm with 8 rainy days. 20-25mm bracket is well below average (drier). Six days into May with cooler showery weather pattern, monthly total may track near or below average. Probability of landing exactly in 20-25mm 5mm bin is low (~10-15% given variance).
assessment.key_uncertainty: Total May rainfall volatility around lower bracket.
